security_wiring.credential_storage: API key and base URL encrypted in OpenVikingProfileRepository; public profile exposes configured/masked status only

security_wiring.ready_guard: operations, upload, text import, connection-resource import, and item operations require ready profile
security_wiring.ssrf: DNS/IP validation rejects private, loopback except dev HTTP loopback, link-local, multicast, reserved, unspecified; redirects disabled
security_wiring.tenant_isolation: profile repository get/list/delete scoped by tenant_id and workspace_id
security_wiring.url_policy: production HTTPS only; dev HTTP exception only for localhost/127.0.0.1/[::1] loopback with DNS/IP validation
